name: publicWeb_getKennels
description: Returns the URL slug for every active kennel that has a KennelWebsite row. Used by the Next.js sitemap index to generate per-kennel sitemap references at build/revalidation time. No authentication required.

rowsets.name: KennelSlugs
rowsets.description: One row per kennel with a KennelWebsite row, ordered alphabetically by slug.

columns.name: Slug
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — the URL path segment for this kennel

codeSmells.detail: The SP has no error handling. A runtime error will propagate as an unstructured SQL exception rather than the standard error envelope. Low risk for a simple SELECT, but inconsistent with all other HC6 SPs.

Returns kennels that have a KennelWebsite row regardless of whether Enabled = 1. Kennels with Enabled = 0 (website disabled/under construction) will appear in the sitemap. Consider adding AND kw.Enabled = 1 to the WHERE clause.

breakingChangeRules: Never rename Slug — the Next.js getStaticParams caller expects this exact column name
